name: Trees
overview: Scripture reveals that trees were created by God to yield fruit and seed according to their kinds, serving both as food for humanity and animals and as a display of His good design (Genesis 1:11-12, 1:29-30). Trees are described as pleasant to the sight and good for food, with special significance given to the tree of life and the tree of knowledge of good and evil in the Garden of Eden (Genesis 2:9). Additionally, trees provide practical benefits such as shade during the heat of the day, illustrating God's provision and care for His creation (Genesis 18:1).
